The '''Sentient Greatbow''' is a type of [[Weapons|Weapon]].

It is the direct Upgrade of the [[Living Bow]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Sentient Weapons evolve from their craftable Living counterpart after having dealt 50,000 damage.

== ''Usage'' ==

The Sentient Greatbow is one of currently 2 ranged weapons, the other being it's predecessor to which it currently acts identically. Each second the bow is pulled, 1 bonus point is added to the base value (1) up to a cap of 3 overall points. After the shot is released, the damage of the arrow itself will be multiplied with the stacked bonus points, yielding the same damage as it's Living version.

Arrows fired by the Sentient Greatbow inflict [[Bleeding|Bleeding I]] and [[Concussive Smoke Trail]] for ten seconds each, unaffected by draw length.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*The Sentient Greatbow was inspired by the Luanwulf Greatbow, from Black Desert Online.
